title: ExtractedEvent
description: Standardized event schema extracted from heterogeneous field progress reports for SIH26122 (Setu)

activity_phrase.description: Extracted activity description phrase, e.g. spool erected on Line 24-PL-001

tag_or_line_id.description: Engineering tag, line number, equipment ID, or spool number (e.g. Line 24-PL-001, TK-101, P-201A)

location.description: Site unit, plot, bay, or geographical section (e.g. Refinery Unit 02, Pump Bay 4)

event_date.description: ISO formatted date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the logged event

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. joints, meters, cum, MT, nos)

contractor.description: Executing contractor or subcontractor name (e.g. L&T, Punj Lloyd, Bridge & Roof)

delay_reason.description: Reported delay reason or bottleneck (e.g. Heavy monsoon rainfall, Crane permit awaited)

source_document.description: Filename or identifier of the source file / stream (e.g. DPR_2026-08-24_Piping.txt)

source_excerpt.description: Exact verbatim original sentence, row, or utterance — essential for auditability

raw_confidence_hint.description: Optional parsing confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) indicating extractor certainty
